title: Irish Lamb Stew Chinese Fusion
description: A hearty Irish lamb stew with a Chinese twist, blending tender lamb with vegetables in a savory soy-based broth.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb cubes in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per batch.
Remove the browned lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the pot and sauté the chopped onion until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the browned lamb back to the pot, along with the soy sauce, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2-3 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Stir in the sesame oil before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions and toasted sesame seeds, if desired.
